lines: Men in strange uniforms are scaring people at the fountain!
Cipher Peon: Orre belongs to Cipher! Our Shadow Pokemon can't be stopped!

player_won: Peon: Retreat! Tell the admins a trainer with real Pokemon is here!

done: The fountain sparkles again. Phenac is safe, for now.

lines: Rui: You beat them! Did you see that dark aura? Those were Shadow Pokemon.
Cipher closes Pokemon's hearts so they only want to fight. It's so cruel!
Team Snagem left this machine behind when Cipher took over: a Snag Machine.
With it you can catch a Shadow Pokemon from a Cipher trainer and save it!
Take Shadow Pokemon to the Relic Stone in Agate Village to open their hearts.

travel_options.message: The plane lifts off over the desert. Next stop: Lilycove City in Hoenn.

intro: The crowd is cheering for you!
Justy: The Phenac Stadium final! Show Orre a real battle!
player_won: Justy: You're the Phenac Stadium champion!
player_lost: Justy: The stadium is open every day. Come back!

lines: You rev the motorbike and race across the dunes.
Sand sprays behind you. Orre has no tall grass, only desert, rock and wind.
Sheriff: Pyrite's a rough town, kid. Outlaws on every corner.
Lately Cipher's been running things from The Under, the old city below us.
Clear them out and Agate Village will want to meet you.

intro: Miror B.: Ooh, a challenger! Let's dance! My Ludicolo never miss a beat!
player_won: Miror B.: Aaah! My groove! You win this round, baby!
player_lost: Miror B.: Ha! Keep dancing and come back!

lines: Cipher Admin Venus: How dare you march into my studio!
My Shadow Pokemon are beautiful, and you'll see how beautiful in battle!

player_won: Venus: My makeup... ruined! Fine, The Under is yours!

lines: Elder Eagun: So you're the trainer who saved Pyrite. Rui told me everything.
The Relic Stone in our forest can open a Shadow Pokemon's heart. Use it whenever you need.
Cipher's leader hides in Realgam Tower. When you're ready, end this.
Elder Eagun: The Relic Stone can open a Shadow Pokemon's heart, if you wish it.
Some trainers keep their Shadow Pokemon as they are. Choose one to purify, or none.

fail: The Relic Stone glows softly. The forest feels like it's waiting for something.
lines: Every Shadow Pokemon you saved gathers around the Relic Stone.
A shooting star falls into the forest... and a tiny Pokemon with a star on its head wakes up!
It's Jirachi, the Wish Pokemon. It looks at you, curious.

intro: Dakim: Crush! I'll crush you and your Pokemon!
Ein: My research made the Shadow Pokemon. You will not undo it!
Evice: So you're the meddler. Realgam Tower is mine, and so is Orre!
player_won: Rui: You did it! Every Shadow Pokemon can be saved now!
player_lost: Evice: Cipher cannot be beaten! Leave my tower!

requirements.fail_text: Realgam Tower's doors are sealed. Talk to the elder in Agate Village first.

lines: The files list the Shadow Pokemon Cipher made here.
One note says: "A wishing star fell near Agate's Relic Stone. Investigate."
Another: "Project XD: ship the new Shadow Pokemon through Gateon Port."
Sailor: Cipher's back, they say. New Shadow Pokemon, and a ship nobody can find.
Start at their lab outside town. Then the ONBS building, the Key Lair... and Citadark Isle.
Cipher Admin Lovrina: You found my lab? My lovely Shadow Pokemon will deal with you!

player_won: Lovrina: Ugh! Fine, the ONBS building is next. Not that it'll help you!

lines: Cipher Commander Exol: The Orre news station is ours. Shadow Pokemon on every channel!

player_won: Exol: Broadcast cut... The Key Lair in Pyrite holds the real secrets.

lines: Cipher Admin Gorigan: Here's where Cipher keeps its keys. You'll go no further!

player_won: Gorigan: The key... to Citadark Isle. Take it, then. Greevil is waiting.

lines: Grand Master Greevil: So you crossed the sea to my island. Cipher will rule Orre!

player_won: Greevil: My Shadow Pokemon... my perfect plan... Cipher is finished!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Welcome to Orre
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher Peons are attacking Phenac City's fountain. Stop them and meet Rui.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Pyrite and The Under
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher runs Pyrite Town from The Under. Snag their Shadow Pokemon and beat Admin Venus.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Realgam Tower
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Purify your Shadow Pokemon at Agate's Relic Stone, then take down Cipher at Realgam Tower.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Wishing Star
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher's files mention a wishing star near Agate's Relic Stone.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Gale of Darkness
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher is back under Greevil. Clear the lairs from Gateon Port and stop him on Citadark Isle.
